dog.description_text:
Hi! I just arrived! My name is Stars and Stripes aka "Queenie".

Here’s a short description:

A 7-week-old puppy is tiny, playful, and full of curiosity. With soft fur, wobbly steps, and bright eyes, they are just beginning to explore the world around them. At this age, they love cuddles, gentle play, and plenty of sleep as they grow and learn every day.

Personality & Characteristics: Playful, independent, fast learner, sleepyhead. I love to jump into my toy bucket and snuggle up like a donut to take my naps.

My foster dog is good with: (Dogs, Kids, havent been around cats)

My foster dog is: (Crate trained, House trained, Low shed)

3 Keywords for your pup: Intelligent, playful, energetic.
Energy Level (1= calm, 10= high energy): 7 regular puppy zoomies and crashes out immediately after. Sleeps the entire night.

Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: Quiet

Walking Manners: None yet, still too young.
Appetite: Loves food and food motivated

Favorite Things: peanut butter, licking mats, kong toy, toy basket to fall asleep.

Commands/Tricks: sit, come, get down, inside crate and hidden talent to randomly howl.

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
